_fuente: PROPUESTA del equipo para Inglés II (CEFR A2). NO proviene de la planeación oficial.
_nota: Pendiente de reemplazar con la planeación oficial de Inglés II del profesor Jhoan Segura. Mantiene la misma estructura que syllabus-ingles-1.json (3 cortes) y evita las semanas de exámenes (5-6, 11-12, 16-17), la semana 1 y la 15, igual que Inglés I.

unidades.descripcion: Rutinas, gustos y comida: hablar del día a día con presente simple.

temas.objetivo: Describir la rutina diaria y la de otras personas, con la frecuencia de cada actividad.
gramatica: Present simple: affirmative, negative and questions
frasesModelo: I usually wake up at six o'clock.
She never has breakfast at home.
What time do you get up?
He always takes the bus to university.
Do you study every day? Yes, I do.

temas.objetivo: Hablar de pasatiempos y de lo que le gusta o no le gusta hacer.
frasesModelo: I love playing soccer on weekends.
She hates watching horror movies.
What do you do in your free time?
Can you swim? No, I can't.
My favorite hobby is dancing.

temas.objetivo: Pedir comida y hablar de cantidades en un restaurante o en el mercado.
frasesModelo: I would like some chicken and rice, please.
Is there any water in the fridge?
How much bread do we need?
How many eggs do you want?
Can I see the menu, please?

unidades.titulo: Second Term: Places and past events
unidades.descripcion: Describir lugares y contar lo que pasó el fin de semana.

temas.objetivo: Describir la ciudad y dar indicaciones sencillas.
frasesModelo: There is a bank next to the park.
There are two supermarkets on my street.
Turn left and go straight.
The hospital is opposite the church.
Is there a pharmacy near here?

temas.objetivo: Describir lo que las personas están haciendo en este momento.
frasesModelo: I am studying English right now.
She is cooking dinner at the moment.
What are you doing?
They are waiting for the bus.
He is not working today.

temas.objetivo: Contar lo que hizo el fin de semana pasado.
gramatica: Past simple of be: was and were
Time expressions: yesterday, last weekend, ago
frasesModelo: Last weekend I visited my grandparents.
Yesterday I watched a movie at home.
Were you at the party? Yes, I was.
We played basketball two days ago.
She stayed at home on Sunday.

unidades.titulo: Third Term: Stories, plans and comparisons
unidades.descripcion: Contar experiencias, hablar de planes y comparar.

temas.objetivo: Contar experiencias y momentos importantes de la vida.
frasesModelo: I was born in Villavicencio.
I went to the beach last year.
Did you meet your best friend at school?
She didn't see the message.
We moved to Bogotá in 2020.

temas.objetivo: Hablar de planes e intenciones para el futuro.
frasesModelo: I am going to travel to Cartagena next month.
What are you going to do tomorrow?
She is going to graduate next year.
We are not going to work on Sunday.
My plan is to learn English very well.
My city is bigger than my town.
This phone is more expensive than that one.
Who is the tallest person in your family?
Summer is the best season of the year.
The bus is cheaper than a taxi.
